seed.text: The Nimbus Router X1 is a compact mesh router with two gigabit ports and a single-pane setup wizard for home networks.
To reset the Nimbus Router X1 to factory settings, hold the recessed button for ten seconds until the status light turns amber.
The Aperture Sensor S2 reports temperature and humidity every five minutes over a low-power wireless link to the gateway.
Billing for the Aperture Sensor S2 is monthly per device; a gateway is included with the first two sensors on an annual plan.
